headline: Ministry of Industry and Trade Warns of Risk of Power Shortages from 2027
summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Industry and Trade said 2026 electricity supply will broadly meet demand, but forecast shortages rising from 2.9 billion kWh in 2027 to 61.18 billion kWh in 2030 if projects lag.
why: Electricity supply constraints affect industrial output, manufacturing costs and foreign investment decisions in Vietnam's export-oriented economy.
